requirements: Teachers can mark student attendance via a QR-code scan at the start of each class
Parents receive an SMS alert when a student is marked absent for more than two consecutive days
Students can view their attendance history, including dates and reasons for absences, through a web portal
Admins can generate attendance reports for individual students, classes, or entire schools
Teachers can enter attendance comments for students, such as reasons for tardiness or excused absences
Parents can submit attendance excuses for their children through an online form, which is then reviewed by Teachers
Students can request attendance corrections if they believe their attendance has been marked incorrectly
Admins can configure attendance policies, including thresholds for automatic alerts and excused absence limits
Attendance data must sync within 5 seconds so teachers see live counts during class
The system must support at least 10,000 concurrent student logins during peak hours
The attendance QR-code scanner must be able to handle low-light conditions and damaged QR codes
The system must be able to handle a minimum of 500 attendance records per second during peak attendance marking periods
The web portal must be accessible on a variety of devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones, with a minimum screen resolution of 1024x768

risk_report.stage: Gather Requirements
risk_report.risk: Inadequate requirements gathering may lead to misunderstandings of stakeholder needs.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and workshops to validate requirements.

risk_report.stage: Create System Design
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent system design may result in integration issues and technical debt.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a clear design framework and review process to ensure consistency.

risk_report.stage: Design Database Schema
risk_report.risk: Poor database schema design may lead to data inconsistencies and performance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage a database expert to review and optimize the schema design.

risk_report.stage: Design User Interface
risk_report.risk: A poorly designed user interface may lead to user frustration and low adoption rates.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user experience (UX) research and testing to inform interface design decisions.

risk_report.stage: Implement QR-Code Scanner
risk_report.risk: QR-code scanner implementation issues may cause attendance marking errors.
risk_report.mitigation: Test the QR-code scanner with various devices and scenarios to ensure reliability.

risk_report.stage: Implement Attendance Marking
risk_report.risk: Attendance marking functionality may contain logical errors, affecting data accuracy.
risk_report.mitigation: Perform thorough unit testing and code reviews to ensure correct functionality.

risk_report.stage: Implement Attendance Comments
risk_report.risk: Attendance comment functionality may be vulnerable to abuse or data breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement input validation, data encryption, and access controls to secure comment data.

risk_report.stage: Implement Attendance Excuse System
risk_report.risk: The excuse system may be exploited or contain loopholes, undermining attendance tracking.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a robust excuse validation process and establish clear policies for excuse submission and approval.

risk_report.stage: Implement Attendance Correction Requests
risk_report.risk: Correction request functionality may be misused or contain errors, affecting data integrity.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a clear correction request workflow and implement audit trails to track changes.

risk_report.stage: Implement Admin Configuration
risk_report.risk: Admin configuration errors or lack of access controls may compromise system security.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement role-based access controls and validate admin configuration settings to prevent unauthorized changes.

risk_report.stage: Implement Attendance Reports
risk_report.risk: Report generation issues may lead to inaccurate or incomplete attendance data.
risk_report.mitigation: Thoroughly test report generation with various data sets and scenarios to ensure accuracy.

risk_report.stage: Implement SMS Alert System
risk_report.risk: SMS alert system issues may cause notification failures or unnecessary messages.
risk_report.mitigation: Test the SMS alert system with different carriers and scenarios to ensure reliable message delivery.

risk_report.stage: Implement Web Portal
risk_report.risk: Web portal security vulnerabilities may expose sensitive attendance data.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities.

risk_report.stage: Conduct Unit Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate unit testing may allow defects to go undetected, affecting system reliability.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive unit testing strategy and ensure adequate test coverage.

risk_report.stage: Conduct Integration Testing
risk_report.risk: Integration testing issues may mask defects, leading to system failures in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Perform thorough integration testing, including end-to-end testing and scenario-based testing.

risk_report.stage: Conduct Performance Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate performance testing may result in system crashes or slow performance under load.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct load testing and stress testing to identify performance bottlenecks and optimize system configuration.

risk_report.stage: Conduct Security Testing
risk_report.risk: Security testing gaps may leave the system vulnerable to attacks or data breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage a security expert to conduct thorough security testing, including penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.

risk_report.stage: Conduct User Acceptance Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate user acceptance testing may lead to user dissatisfaction or system rejection.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve end-users in the testing process to ensure the system meets their needs and expectations.

risk_report.stage: Deploy System to Production
risk_report.risk: Deployment issues may cause system downtime or data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a detailed deployment plan, including rollback procedures and backup strategies.

risk_report.stage: Monitor System Performance
risk_report.risk: Inadequate monitoring may lead to undetected issues, affecting system reliability and user experience.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a monitoring framework to track system performance, latency, and error rates, and set up alerts for anomalies.

requirements: Teachers must be able to mark student attendance via a biometric fingerprint scan within 3 seconds of class start time to ensure real-time accuracy.
The system shall automatically flag students with attendance below 80% for the Admin to review and generate a warning notification to parents via email.
Parents shall receive an instant push notification on their mobile app when their child is marked absent without prior notification.
Students shall be able to view their own attendance records for the current semester through a dedicated mobile interface, sorted by subject and date.
The Admin shall generate a consolidated attendance report for a specific class or teacher, including tardiness patterns and absence trends, exportable as a PDF.
Teachers shall be able to override incorrect attendance entries within 24 hours of marking, with the system logging the change and notifying the Admin.
The system shall integrate with the school’s timetable API to auto-populate class lists and attendance schedules based on the current academic calendar.
Students with repeated absences shall be automatically added to a disciplinary review list, accessible only to the Admin and School Counselor.
The system must support up to 500 concurrent teacher logins during peak attendance marking periods (e.g., first 10 minutes of each class) with a response time under 2 seconds.
Attendance data must be backed up to an encrypted cloud storage every 15 minutes to prevent data loss in case of local server failure.
The mobile app for parents and students must function offline and sync attendance data once a stable internet connection is restored.
Biometric attendance scanning must comply with GDPR standards for data protection, ensuring fingerprint data is stored locally and never transmitted to external servers.
The system shall generate an audit log of all attendance changes, including timestamps, user IDs, and reasons for modifications, retained for a minimum of 5 years.

risk_report.stage: Define system architecture and technical requirements
risk_report.risk: Incomplete or ambiguous requirements may lead to scope creep or system misalignment.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder workshops and formalize requirements with sign-off.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema for attendance, users, and audit logs
risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may cause performance bottlenecks or data integrity issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize schema for efficiency and implement indexing strategies for frequent queries.

risk_report.stage: Design biometric fingerprint storage and GDPR compliance mechanism
risk_report.risk: Biometric data storage may violate GDPR or lead to security breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Use irreversible hashing (e.g., FIDO2) and implement strict access controls with DPO oversight.

risk_report.stage: Design mobile app UI/UX for parents, students, and teachers
risk_report.risk: Poor UX may lead to low adoption or user errors in attendance marking.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct iterative usability testing with target users before finalizing designs.

risk_report.stage: Design admin dashboard for reports and disciplinary review
risk_report.risk: Dashboard may lack critical data or overwhelm users with irrelevant metrics.
risk_report.mitigation: Prioritize key metrics based on admin workflows and conduct user validation sessions.

risk_report.stage: Design API endpoints for timetable integration and data sync
risk_report.risk: API changes may break downstream integrations or cause sync failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Version API endpoints and implement backward-compatible changes with deprecation warnings.

risk_report.stage: Set up development environment and CI/CD pipeline
risk_report.risk: Environment inconsistencies may lead to deployment failures or security gaps.
risk_report.mitigation: Use infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and enforce peer reviews for pipeline changes.

risk_report.stage: Implement backend services for attendance marking and real-time processing
risk_report.risk: Real-time processing delays may cause attendance data to become stale.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement message queues (e.g., Kafka) and optimize database transaction isolation.

risk_report.stage: Implement biometric fingerprint scanning module with local storage
risk_report.risk: Local storage of biometric data may be compromised or fail to meet GDPR standards.
risk_report.mitigation: Store only encrypted hashes and ensure local data is wiped after sync with backend.

risk_report.stage: Implement mobile app for parents and students (offline-first)
risk_report.risk: Offline sync conflicts may corrupt attendance or user data.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement conflict resolution strategies (e.g., last-write-wins with timestamps) and sync validation.

risk_report.stage: Implement teacher web interface for attendance marking
risk_report.risk: Teacher errors in marking attendance may lead to inaccurate records.
risk_report.mitigation: Add confirmation dialogs and audit trails for attendance changes.

risk_report.stage: Implement admin dashboard with reporting and disciplinary tools
risk_report.risk: Disciplinary tools may be misused or lack necessary context for decisions.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement role-based access controls and require justification for disciplinary actions.

risk_report.stage: Integrate timetable API for auto-populating class lists
risk_report.risk: API downtime or data mismatches may disrupt attendance workflows.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement fallback data sources and alerting for API failures.

risk_report.stage: Implement automated attendance threshold checks and notifications
risk_report.risk: False positives in threshold checks may lead to unnecessary alerts or missed critical cases.
risk_report.mitigation: Tune thresholds based on historical data and allow manual override with justification.

risk_report.stage: Implement audit logging system with 5-year retention
risk_report.risk: Audit logs may be tampered with or fail to meet retention requirements.
risk_report.mitigation: Use immutable storage (e.g., WORM) and implement automated log rotation with checksums.

risk_report.stage: Implement encrypted cloud backup system with 15-minute intervals
risk_report.risk: Backup failures may lead to data loss during critical failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement multi-region backups with automated integrity verification and alerting.

risk_report.stage: Unit test all backend services and API endpoints
risk_report.risk: Incomplete test coverage may allow undetected bugs to reach production.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce 100% branch coverage and integrate mutation testing for critical paths.

risk_report.stage: Unit test mobile app functionality and offline sync
risk_report.risk: Mobile-specific bugs (e.g., network interruptions) may go untested.
risk_report.mitigation: Use device farms and simulate real-world network conditions in tests.

risk_report.stage: Integration test biometric scanning with backend
risk_report.risk: Biometric integration may fail due to hardware or software inconsistencies.
risk_report.mitigation: Test with multiple device models and implement fallback authentication methods.

risk_report.stage: Performance test system for 500 concurrent logins with <2s response
risk_report.risk: Performance bottlenecks may degrade user experience during peak usage.
risk_report.mitigation: Use load testing tools (e.g., JMeter) and optimize database queries and caching.

risk_report.stage: Security and GDPR compliance testing for biometric data
risk_report.risk: Undetected vulnerabilities may expose biometric data or violate GDPR.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct third-party penetration testing and GDPR compliance audits.

risk_report.stage: User acceptance testing with teachers, parents, and admin
risk_report.risk: User feedback may reveal critical usability issues late in development.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve users early in design phases and iterate based on feedback.

risk_report.stage: Deploy backend services to production servers
risk_report.risk: Deployment errors may cause downtime or data corruption.
risk_report.mitigation: Use blue-green deployments and automated rollback mechanisms.

risk_report.stage: Deploy mobile apps to app stores
risk_report.risk: App store rejections or delays may impact release timelines.
risk_report.mitigation: Submit apps early for review and address feedback iteratively.

risk_report.stage: Monitor system performance during peak attendance periods
risk_report.risk: Undetected performance degradation may lead to system failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time monitoring (e.g., Prometheus) and automated scaling.

risk_report.stage: Conduct post-deployment review and address feedback
risk_report.risk: Unaddressed feedback may lead to long-term user dissatisfaction.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a formal feedback loop with prioritization and tracking.
